scripts.dev: concurrently -n NEXT,API -c cyan,green "next dev -p 3000" "cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000"
scripts.dev:reset: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-Process -Name node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (Test-Path .next) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .next }; npm run dev"
